record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Fixed Point Properties
record.original_question: Let S be a semitopological semigroup. Consider the fixed point property (fpp*) saying that whenever S = {T_s : s in S} is represented by norm nonexpansive mappings on a nonempty weak* compact convex subset C of the dual E* of a Banach space E, and the action map (s, x) -> T_s(x) from S x C to C is jointly continuous when C carries the weak* topology, then C contains a common fixed point for S. If LUC(S), the space of left uniformly continuous bounded functions on S, has a left invariant mean, must S have property (fpp*)?

evidence.quote: (fpp∗) Whenever S = {Ts : s ∈ S} is a representation of S as norm nonex￾pansive mappings on a nonempty weak* compact convex set C of the dual space of a Banach space E and the mapping (s, x) 7→ Ts(x) from S × C to C is jointly continuous, where C is equipped with the weak* topology of E∗, then there is a common fixed point for S in C.
Problem 2.1. Does a semitopological semigroup S have the fixed point property (fpp∗) if LUC(S) has a LIM?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a semitopological semigroup (a semigroup endowed with a Hausdorff topology such that for each $s\in S$ the maps $t\mapsto st$ and $t\mapsto ts$ are continuous on $S$). Let $\mathrm{CB}(S)$ denote the space of bounded continuous real-valued functions on $S$ with the supremum norm, and for $s\in S$ and $f\in \mathrm{CB}(S)$ define $(\ell_s f)(t)=f(st)$. The space $\mathrm{LUC}(S)$ of left uniformly continuous bounded functions on $S$ consists of all $f\in \mathrm{CB}(S)$ for which the map $s\mapsto \ell_s f$ from $S$ into $\mathrm{CB}(S)$ is norm continuous. A left invariant mean (LIM) on $\mathrm{LUC}(S)$ is a continuous linear functional $m$ on $\mathrm{LUC}(S)$ with $m(1)=\|m\|=1$ such that $m(\ell_s f)=m(f)$ for every $s\in S$ and every $f\in \mathrm{LUC}(S)$.

Say that $S$ has the fixed point property $(\mathrm{fpp}^*)$ if the following holds: whenever $E$ is a Banach space, $C$ is a nonempty weak$^*$-compact convex subset of the dual space $E^*$, and $\mathcal{S}=\{T_s:s\in S\}$ is a representation of $S$ as norm-nonexpansive self-mappings of $C$ (i.e., $T_{st}=T_s\circ T_t$ for all $s,t\in S$ and $\|T_s x-T_s y\|\le \|x-y\|$ for all $x,y\in C$, $s\in S$) such that the action map $(s,x)\mapsto T_s(x)$ from $S\times C$ to $C$ is jointly continuous when $C$ carries the weak$^*$ topology, then there exists $x_0\in C$ with $T_s x_0=x_0$ for every $s\in S$.

Question: Does every semitopological semigroup $S$ for which $\mathrm{LUC}(S)$ admits a left invariant mean necessarily have property $(\mathrm{fpp}^*)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The implication is posed as an open problem in the literature on fixed point properties for semigroups of nonexpansive mappings on weak*-compact convex sets. Related results are known (e.g., for AP(S), WAP(S), and partial converses), but a search did not turn up a published proof or counterexample resolving this specific implication for general semitopological semigroups.

status_evidence.title: Normal Structure and Common Fixed Point Properties for Semigroups of Nonexpansive Mappings
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses fixed point properties tied to invariant means on subspaces of CB(S), including LUC(S), for semitopological semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Related fixed point properties for nonexpansive representations of semitopological semigroups under invariant-mean hypotheses are studied, but the LUC(S)-LIM ⇒ (fpp*) implication is not established in general.

status_evidence.title: On the Schauder fixed point property
status_evidence.snippet: Treats fixed point properties for semigroups acting on convex sets, in line with Lau-type problems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to investigate connections between invariant means on LUC(S) and weak*-fixed point properties, suggesting the question remains active.
